mathematical_checks.finding: The explicit induced cocycle gives PhiCond for every open subgroup, including nonnormal subgroups. The finite-H1 applications use exactly the unchanged CohP.gf/lf fields, their finite discrete permutation modules, and the original global and local Galois groups.

The residual subgroup is exactly H_eq. Polarized determinant identities prove its invariance under complex conjugation, so no replacement normal core or factorial division is introduced. The empty-rank case is explicitly covered.

Relative PL kills every additive residual character and contains the pro-ell-kernel inertia images. The normal Frattini tower is proved cofinal over this exact relative PL by finite quotients and compactness; it is not asserted cofinal over the identity.

The primary Chebotarev application has finite Galois number-field data and finite exclusions. Exact Frobenius at a chosen valuation, degree-one absolute norm, inverse-limit lifting, original CM splitting, and pairwise distinct base primes are independently derived. The source algebraic closure and valuations are retained.

Every field of the original Glob.Hom level map is matched. New inertia lies in the preimage of the old H; proker-to-PL, the actual tame generator, closed normal generation, and valuation transport give ker(p) inside the stated relative PL normal closure.

The finite character evaluation array has q*[Gamma:H] coordinates. Equal arrays give a descended character on the same H, producing the single hb=#HomL(H)*ell^(q*[Gamma:H]) uniformly over all N. Empty-list and rank edge cases are preserved.

Arithmetic Frobenius sigma is chosen near g inverse. Normality gives the exact ph=fr=sigma inverse approximation, and the source tame relation becomes (tau^Nq)^(-1)*(ph^(-1)*tau*ph) in PL with the correct orientation. Cyclotomic norm congruences include N=0.

All original TWGrp and TWPl fields are supplied for every N with the same q/list/H and one hb, including exact level maps, equality H_eq, chosen valuations, Frobenius and inertia generators. PhiCond precedes the arbitrary list. This proves the complete original ArPl implication conditional on CohP.

Choice, then list realization, then subsequent automorphic application is the correct order. ArPl chooses no ideal. The two original rank-four Links, fixed-iota/common-threshold order, common kappa, distinct primes, ell=3, and same original J are retained. HasAut, B1, B2 and Raw are not inferred.

Complex characters separate a finite abelian image, so the exact IsLocalArtin.factor law gives constancy on Artin fibers for all original finite-image residual characters. Actual artOf validity uses the inherited CIP4 endpoint; no replacement local reciprocity map is selected.

Unramified residual characters give valuation- and Frobenius-independent inverse-Frobenius polynomial coefficients. The exact q-power normalization agrees with heckePol, q is a unit at ell, and all lifts stay in the same original coefficient ring.

A single residual value function a is chosen before any later ordinary module or ideal. Both full IsRes fields hold for arbitrary original V/QData/c/m and every supplied tau0, including every Artin uniformizer preimage and the exact ordered products. No V.Sprime=s.S restriction, coefficient extension, or type-existence claim is introduced.
